testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.gateway.IdempotencyTests

testcase.name: a store that fails after a successful write does not turn the success into an error()
the key appears in no log line, audit record or printed request()
a store that fails while recording an ambiguous failure still leaves the key unusable()
concurrent retries of one key run the mutation exactly once()
an ambiguous failure keeps the key reserved - the retry does not run a second write()
a definite not-executed failure frees the key()
reservations expire with the idempotency window()
the reservation is per tenant, data source and mutation()
the unknown state is exact about parameters - a different payload under that key is still a conflict()
the derived key shape sha256 base64url is accepted and the other encodings are not()
a holder that vanished does not free the key - after its lease the outcome is unknown, not retryable()
